Overview

iPhone 15 is listed in our worldwide phone directory. Country or market recorded: not recorded. This is an evergreen reference guide, not a new launch or a claim that the institution or product was recently announced.

Source-listed information

  • Manufacturer: Apple Inc.
  • Display: The iPhone 15 features a 6.1-inch (155 mm) display with Super Retina XDR OLED technology at a resolution of 2556×1179 pixels and a pixel density of about 460 PPI with a refresh rate of 60 Hz. The iPhone 15 Plus features a 6.7-inch (170 mm) display with the same technology at a resolution of 2796×1290 pixels and a pixel density of about 460 PPI. Both models have an improved typical brightness of up to 1,000 nits , a peak HDR brightness of up to 1,600 nits, and a peak outdoor brightness of up to 2,000 nits. [ 9 ] The Dynamic Island feature, previously exclusive to iPhone 14 Pro , is now standard on iPhone 15, replacing the notch that was introduced in the iPhone X. [ 19 ]
  • Battery: The iPhone 15 offers users up to 20 hours of video playback and up to 80 hours of audio playback, and the iPhone 15 Plus offers around 25 to 30% more, with up to 26 hours of video playback and up to 100 hours of audio playback. [ 24 ] Consumer Reports noted a battery life of 53 hours for the 15 Plus version based on a robotic testing paradigm, placing as the longest battery life out of seventy-three smartphones tested (including newer iPhone models). [ 25 ] Starting with iPhone 15, iPhone allows users to limit the battery charge level, in order to help with natural battery aging over time. [ 26 ]
  • Ram: 6 GB
  • Storage: 128 GB, 256 GB or 512 GB NVMe
  • Cameras: 48 MP, f / 1.6, 26 mm equiv. [ A 1 ] (wide) 12 MP, f / 2.4, 13 mm, equiv. (ultrawide)
  • Charging: MagSafe and Qi2 wireless charging [ 6 ] USB-C (fast-charge capable: up to 50% charge in 30 minutes with 20W adaptor or higher) (Up to 50% charge in 20 minutes with 40W adaptor or higher)
  • Connectivity: Bluetooth 5.3 ( A2DP , LE ), Ultra-wideband (UWB), USB-C (with DisplayPort support [ 8 ] ), Wi-Fi 6 (802.11a/b/g/n/ac/ax) dual-band, NFC (reader mode, Express Cards) GPS , GLONASS , Galileo , QZSS , BeiDou
  • Os: Original : iOS 17 Current: iOS 27.2 , released October 26, 2026 ( 2026-10-26 ) [ 2 ]
  • Front Camera: 12 MP, f / 1.9, 23 mm equiv. (wide) SL 3D (depth/biometrics)
  • Weight: 15 : 171 g (6.0 oz) 15 Plus : 201 g (7.1 oz) [ 1 ]
  • Dimensions: dimensions: 15 : H: 147.6 mm (5.81 in) W: 71.6 mm (2.82 in) D: 7.8 mm (0.31 in) 15 Plus : H: 160.9 mm (6.33 in) W: 77.8 mm (3.06 in) D: 7.8 mm (0.31 in) [ 1 ]
  • Protection: IP68 dust/water resistant (up to 6m for 30 minutes)

How to compare specifications

Check the exact regional model, chipset, screen, battery capacity, charging standards, camera hardware, storage, network bands and promised software updates against manufacturer documentation.

Price and availability

Prices vary by market, storage option, taxes and date. Confirm the live selling price, warranty, launch status and availability with the manufacturer or authorized retailer.

Buyer checklist

Check regional warranty, supported networks, return policy, update commitments, accessories and repair availability before purchase.

Verification and limitations
